title: Distributed Cognition Exits Stealth With Verdict Capital Backing for Collective AI
summary:
A network of specialized and interdependent AI models is being developed to prevent a few entities from controlling the future of machine intelligence. Distributed Cognition, which ended its stealth period on Oct. 22, is building communication layers and adapters to allow these specialized models to coordinate their efforts and combine their strengths. The company received financial backing from Verdict Capital to pursue a mission of replicating human collective intelligence.

The venture argues that the current concentration of AI power enables a small number of actors to restrict how people think and act. While the research direction of collective intelligence is viewed by some as promising, the success of the approach depends on whether coordination costs can be managed as the networks of models expand.

selectedTweets.text:
Today distributed cognition exits out of stealth with backing by Verdict Capital.

Our mission is to replicate humanity's collective intelligence.
Read more: https://t.co/PqqgbLXbkc

Most of today's AI power is held in the hands of a few, who can choose what you're allowed to think and what you're permitted to do.

We stand on three substantially different foundational beliefs:
- You shouldn't ask permission for intelligence.
- Superintelligence will be a distributed collective.
- Humans are not meant to be relegated to a permanent underclass.

If we don't distribute intelligence, nobody will.

Superintelligence could look a lot like human civilization: different minds building on each other's work.

Distributed Cognition is taking that idea seriously. They're building communication layers and adapters to help specialized models work together, combining what each does well.

I'd love to see AI get better at this. So much of what humans have achieved comes from learning how to think and build together.
